name: resource-max-segment
title: Maximum resource segment
summary: Repeated transfer of one maximum-efficient resource segment.
description: Sequential maximum-size resource transfers over one link for a fixed wall-time - the bulk mechanism: one sealed stream sliced into parts, pulled by the receiver inside its AIMD window, proved whole by hash. Goodput counts settled transfers' payload bytes; the protocol itself hash-verifies every byte that arrives.
conformance: Every sent transfer settles and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; the receiver hash-proves each resource before settlement.
